QUOTE: `archiveChannel` ... "Calls `setChannelDeleteAt(now)` locally. The channel stays in the DB as archived." (viewable) / "Calls `removeCurrentUserFromChannel`, so the channel is dropped locally." (not viewable); and websocket handler: "If the user is in that channel, `handleKickFromChannel(…, CHANNEL_ARCHIVED)` runs. Then the user is removed from the channel locally." / "Only stores `delete_at`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when archived channels are not viewable, the user is removed from the channel and kicked out if it is the current one. It also states that when they are viewable, the channel is kept with `delete_at` set.
